notes.title: The Farming Frontier Demo Live Stream
notes.content:
[h1][b]The Farming Frontier[/b][/h1]

The Farming Frontier is a nearly idle farming RPG with a riveting story to follow. Grow crops, breed cattle, go fishing, learn crafting, and defeat your enemies. 

This game has 3 modes:

* [b]Campaign[/b]: Complete missions and advance to the next level
* [b]Peaceful sandbox mode[/b]: Chop wood, farm crops, learn crafting etc. without stressing about missions
* [b]Fighting sandbox mode[/b]: Everything in peaceful mode + stress about enemies :)
* Tutorial

In this demo, we'll be playing the Tutorial.
